jobs.description: Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@tebra.com, @patientpop.com, or @kareo.com) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse.Â We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal â not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.About the Role Tebra helps private practices bring modernized care to patients everywhere. To run our own business well, every team needs numbers it can trust. We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help build Tebra's new internal analytics platform. You'll turn data from Salesforce, NetSuite, Stripe, our product, and other systems into one shared, tested set of business data and metrics that Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments all use. You'll lead projects end to end, set the standards others build on, and partner with business leaders to define the metrics that matter most. Your Area of Focus Â Data Modeling & Shared Datasets: Design, build, and maintain enterprise-wide business data that teams across Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments build on. Apply dimensional modeling and layered design (staging, intermediate, and marts) so business logic lives in one place and isn't rebuilt by each team. Metric Definition & Semantic Layer: Partner with metric owners in Finance and the business to define each key metric once, with a named owner and documented logic. Publish governed metrics in a semantic layer that Tableau, AI assistants, and other tools query, and reconcile them to current reporting and the general ledger before teams switch over. Self-Service Enablement: Build easy-to-use datasets that let non-technical teammates and analysts answer their own questions without writing complex joins. Platform Migration: Lead projects end to end on the new internal analytics platform, from source data to dashboards. Move each team's reporting over one domain at a time, with clear cutover and rollback plans, and onboard the analysts who contribute to new conventions, review processes, and tools. Data Quality & Testing: Build automated tests and pull-request checks so data issues are caught before they reach reports. Monitor scheduled jobs, fix failures, and recover runs as part of shared production support. Performance & Efficiency: Tune SQL, models, and pipeline schedules so data refreshes on time and dashboards load in seconds. Monitor compute usage and cost, and choose how each model is built and refreshed to keep both in check. Forecasting & Machine Learning: Partner with analysts and data scientists to prepare clean, documented datasets for forecasting and machine learning models, such as retention and revenue projections. Code Review & Mentorship: Review code from analysts and engineers across teams, and coach them on modeling, SQL, and testing standards. Governance & Documentation: Follow data-sharing and privacy rules that keep protected health information (PHI) and personal data out of internal analytics. Maintain model documentation, lineage, and metric definitions via dbt, GitHub, Confluence, and Jira. Your Professional Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role, with 2+ years hands-on in dbt in production. SQL Fluency: Expert SQL, including window functions, CTEs, and performance tuning for queries and pipelines on large datasets. Data Modeling: Deep proficiency in dimensional modeling (Kimball), including shared datasets that serve many teams. Tech Stack: Proven experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, and with dbt. Business Partnership: Experience defining business metrics with Finance or business stakeholders, and reconciling data to financial systems. Software Mindset: Experience with GitHub for version control and code review, automated builds (GitHub Actions or similar), and Jira and Confluence for work tracking and documentation. Communication: Strong communication with people who aren't data specialists, and ability to execute under minimal supervision. Growth Mindset: Motivated to learn new technologies and develop new skills. Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, economics, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Semantic Layer: Experience with a semantic layer, such as Snowflake semantic views or the dbt Semantic Layer, preferred. Domain Knowledge: Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or Stripe data, and with subscription revenue, retention, or payments metrics, preferred. Forecasting & ML: Experience preparing data for forecasting or machine learning models preferred. Healthcare: Healthcare or HIPAA experience preferred. Additional Tools: Familiarity with Tableau, Terraform, or Okta a plus. Certifications: dbt Analytics Engineering or SnowPro certifications preferred. #LI-SS1 #LI-RemoteWe are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with competitive and fair compensation. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing â so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout â helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Better Together We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together. Celebrate Success Life is short and joy is underrated. Everything we ship is leverage: unify the data, sharpen the intelligence, and streamline execution so every partner marketing team can launch faster, personalize better, and learn continuously. When we get it right, wins scale across all three brands instead of being rebuilt one at a time.We're building teams at the forefront of agentic coding.
